mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM version_baseline_runs WHERE id=1
SELECT FROM ${table} WHERE ${owner}=#{targetId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${table} WHERE ${owner}=#{targetId} AND reason=#{reason}
SELECT FROM ${table} WHERE ${owner}=#{targetId} AND operation_id=#{operationId} AND reason=#{reason}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ${table} WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM ${table} WHERE ${owner}=#{targetId} AND reason IN ('MANUAL_DRAFT','RESTORE_BACKUP','RESTORE') ORDER BY id DESC OFFSET #{keep} ROWS)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.media_id FROM ${mediaTable} m JOIN ${table} v ON v.id=m.version_id WHERE v.${owner}=#{targetId} ORDER BY m.media_id
SELECT v.${owner} AS target_id,v.id AS version_id,v.reason,v.created_at FROM ${table} v JOIN ${mediaTable} m ON m.version_id=v.id WHERE m.media_id=#{mediaId} ORDER BY v.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${table} v JOIN ${mediaTable} m ON m.version_id=v.id WHERE v.${owner}=#{targetId} AND v.id=#{versionId} AND m.media_id=#{mediaId}
